title.en: W fill failure often starts at the barrier

subtitle.zh: 覆盖、孔口形貌与底部界面决定Volcano、Seam和电阻
subtitle.en: Coverage, opening shape and the bottom interface govern volcano defects, seams and resistance

body.zh: 正常Plug；Ti；TiN；W；介质/衬底；连续覆盖|界面干净|无提前闭合
body.en: Normal plug Ti TiN W Dielectric / substrate Continuous coverage | clean interface | no premature closure

body.zh: 1. Volcano；原因；TiN过薄或不连续 → WF₆相关反应失控；先查；先查TiN完整性与前处理
body.en: 1. Volcano Cause TiN too thin or discontinuous → uncontrolled WF₆-related reactions Check first Check TiN integrity and pretreatment first

body.zh: 2. Overhang → Seam；原因；孔口过厚 → 提前闭合；先查；先查Step Coverage与CD
body.en: 2. Overhang → seam Cause Excessive thickness at the opening → premature closure Check first Check step coverage and CD first

body.zh: 3.Void；原因；覆盖失衡 → 空洞被封住；先查；截面确认位置与形貌
body.en: 3. Void Cause Unbalanced coverage → a void becomes sealed inside Check first Confirm location and morphology in cross-section

body.zh: 4. Peeling / 高接触电阻；膜层剥离；界面污染/残留；原因；附着差或底部残留；先查；查Pre-clean、Ti与界面残留
body.en: 4. Peeling / high contact resistance Film peeling Interface contamination / residue Cause Poor adhesion or bottom residue Check first Check pre-clean, Ti and interface residues

body.zh: 看截面形貌；定位失效位置；回查Ti/TiN覆盖；再关联接触电阻
body.en: Inspect cross-sectional morphology Locate the failure Review Ti/TiN coverage Then correlate contact resistance

body.zh: 看到W Void，不等于问题一定出在Bulk W步骤
body.en: A W void does not necessarily mean the fault lies in the bulk-W step
